name: Smooth Hummus & Warm White Pita with Chicken Souvlaki
whyItWorks: Ultra-smooth commercial hummus (peeled pureed chickpeas) in small portions is much gentler than whole beans when paired with white pita and grilled chicken breast.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy classic plain hummus (skip pine nut, roasted red pepper skin, or spicy toppings) and serve with warm white pita toasted in the toaster oven.
